summary: Implemented indeterminate progress tasks (total None) across rich/progress.py, rich/progress_bar.py, docs/source/progress.rst, and tests/test_progress.py. Added TaskProgressColumn, unknown-total handling in bar, Task, time-remaining, total-size, count, and download columns, and finish-detection guards. tests/test_progress.py and tests/test_bar.py pass (55 tests). Full suite has 13 failures that are identical on a clean HEAD export, so they predate this change. Caveats: black is not installed in the shared venv, so formatting was checked by hand only; tests/test_pretty.py cannot be collected because the venv lacks the attr module. Nothing is committed.
